title: Build on Lost Focus
description: Cut part of game content to help focus on building
body:
# ⚠️ This modpack cuts lots of potentially wanted content!
Most cut content is configurable via the Mods tab, otherwise in the config folder!

This modpack cuts a part of the content to eliminate any sort of progression or adventure. The goal is to make the gameplay to mostly consist of building. The modpack is inspired from, but not necessarily similar to Minecraft before Beta 1.8.


<details>
<summary>The following content is cut by default</summary>

- All structures, therefore the End (excl. dungeons)
- Netherite (Ancient Debris is still found)
- Enchantments

</details>

The modpack is intended to be barebones. Additional mods (QoL, etcetc.) can be installed on discretionary basis.
